description: This file contains Flask view classes and functions for managing SQL Lab saved queries, tab states, and table schemas in the Apache Superset project. It handles CRUD operations, activation, migration, and expansion states for SQL queries and schemas.

classes.name: SavedQueryView
classes.description: View for listing saved queries in Superset.

classes.name: TabStateView
classes.description: View for managing tab states, including create, delete, get, activate, update, and migrate queries.

classes.name: TableSchemaView
classes.description: View for managing table schemas, including create, delete, and update expansion state.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Render the list of saved queries.

methods.name: _get_owner_id
methods.description: Retrieve the owner user ID for a given tab state ID.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Create a new tab state from provided query editor data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Delete a tab state and associated schemas.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve details of a specific tab state.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Set a specific tab state as active.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Update fields of a tab state.

methods.name: migrate_query
methods.description: Migrate a query to a specific tab state.

methods.name: delete_query
methods.description: Delete a specific query associated with a tab state.

methods.name: expanded
methods.description: Update the expanded state of a table schema.
